    Corollary 2.4: C(D) is extriangulated #

    Every finite set of objects of C(D) lies in C_J for J = Iic m, and C_J has a triangulated realization built from W = D_m with q_i = π_{mi} (surjective since the transition maps are). So each instance of an axiom holds in C(D) because it holds in some C_J.
